text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen and finding ways to reduce their impact. The first step is to identify risks, which means looking carefully at what could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you need mitigation strategies, which are actions that lower the chance of a risk happening or reduce the damage it causes. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so you have a backup solution ready if things fail. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks can change over time, and regular checks help you respond quickly and keep everything under control.
